_comment: Step 03 judge slate. Fixed BEFORE any results are seen (pre-registration). No API keys live here; keys are read from .env by their *_api_key_env variable name. Prices are USD per 1,000,000 tokens, taken from OpenRouter on 2026-10-20 and used only for projecting cost; the authoritative per-call cost is the amount the API returns in its usage data.

frontier.note: Current OpenAI GA flagship on OpenRouter (listed 2026-04-24). Reasoning model: temperature is not a supported parameter, so it is omitted and logged as 'unsupported'. Reasoning effort is set to the lowest level the model accepts.

low_cost.note: closest available mini; generation differs by one. There is no openai/gpt-5.5-mini on OpenRouter as of 2026-10-20, so the mini of the previous generation (gpt-5.4-mini) is used, as instructed. rpm_limit 20 is OpenRouter's new-account cap for this model (hit 429 three times in the Tamil pairwise pilot).

sea_lion.note: AI Singapore SEA-LION API. Free but rate-limited to 10 requests/min/user (slowest judge). Must be confirmed as served by GET /v1/models before use (step 02 of the plan).

base_model.note: The documented parent of Gemma-SEA-LION-v4-27B-IT (Gemma 3 27B IT). Same base, same size, with vs without SEA regional tuning: the regional-tuning control for RQ1 novelty point 2.

model_families._comment: PARIKSHA response models grouped by the judge family that shares their lineage, for the RQ2 self-preference test. Fixed before results are seen. All four gemma members are present in data/processed/responses.csv.
